properties.split_rationale: Karachi is served by a vertically-integrated private utility with its own generation and a limited NTDC interconnection - the reason it is a zone of its own rather than part of PAK_S.
properties.model_plants: Bin Qasim, Port Qasim, Korangi, KESC units

properties.admin_units: Kunduz, Takhar
properties.split_rationale: Import delivery node, not a generating area: the model gives it zero capacity and only a transfer limit. The polygon is the north-east provinces served by that corridor and by CASA-1000.
properties.grid_area: NEPS import node from Tajikistan (Sherkhan Bandar 220 kV)

properties.admin_units: Sughd Province
properties.split_rationale: Sughd is separated from the rest of Tajikistan by the Zarafshan range and was fed from the Central Asian ring through Uzbekistan; the South-North 500 kV line closed the gap but remains a modelled constraint.

properties.admin_units: Balkh, Samangan, Sar-e-Pul
properties.split_rationale: Import delivery node with no generation; the Hairatan line is Kabul's single largest supply. Polygon = the provinces on that corridor.
properties.grid_area: NEPS import node from Uzbekistan (Hairatan 220 kV)

properties.admin_units: Badghis, Faryab, Jawzjan
properties.split_rationale: Import delivery node with no generation, on the north-western Turkmen feeds.
properties.grid_area: NEPS import node from Turkmenistan (Andkhoy / Sheberghan)

properties.admin_units: Hirat
properties.split_rationale: Herat is not synchronised with the rest of Afghanistan: it is a separate island fed from Iran (Islam Qala) and Turkmenistan, with Salma dam as its only local plant - hence its own zone.

properties.admin_units: Batken, Jalal-Abad, Osh
properties.split_rationale: Hydro-rich half: the Toktogul cascade and the Datka hub that exports to Uzbekistan and Tajikistan.

properties.admin_units: Badakhshan Autonomous Mountainous Region, Cities and districts of the republican subordination, Dushanbe, Khatlon Province
properties.split_rationale: Holds the Vakhsh cascade and the national load centre, and is the export node towards Afghanistan and Pakistan (CASA-1000).

properties.admin_units: Chuy, Naryn, Talas, Ysyk-Kol
properties.split_rationale: Before the Datka-Kemin 500 kV line the Kyrgyz north could only reach the southern cascade through Kazakh and Uzbek networks; the model keeps the two halves as separate nodes with an internal limit.
properties.caveat: Kambarata-2 sits in Jalal-Abad (territorially KGZ_S) but feeds the northern 500 kV corridor, so the model dispatches it in KGZ_N. The polygon follows territory, not this single plant.

properties.admin_units: Baghlan, Bamyan, Daykundi, Ghazni, Hilmand, Kabul, Kandahar, Kapisa, Khost, Kunar, Laghman, Logar, Nangarhar, Nuristan, Paktika, Paktya, Panjsher, Parwan, Uruzgan, Wardak, Zabul
properties.split_rationale: The only Afghan zone with its own generation: the Kabul river plants and Kajaki. Everything the country imports is delivered to it through the four border nodes below.
properties.model_plants: Tarakhil, Naghlu, Sorobi, Darunta, Mahipar, Kajaki, Pul-e-Khumri
properties.caveat: Kandahar, Helmand, Uruzgan and Zabul are physically the separate SEPS island, but the 2020 model carries a single domestic Afghan zone and dispatches Kajaki (Helmand, which supplies SEPS) in it, so they are folded in here. Within the polygon, provinces served only by isolated micro-grids are covered by approximation.

properties.admin_units: Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Federal Capital Territory, Gilgit Baltistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab
properties.split_rationale: Pakistan's system is one long north-south chain. The hydro north and the thermal south are separated by the Guddu / Muzaffargarh transfer bottleneck, which is what the PAK_N-PAK_S link represents.
properties.model_plants: Tarbela, Diamer-Basha, Dasu, Ghazi-Barotha, Mangla, Neelum-Jhelum, Chashma, Muzaffargarh, Kot Addu, Faisalabad, Balloki

properties.admin_units: Badin, Balochistan, Dadu, Ghotki, Hyderabad, Jacobabad, Jamshoro, Kashmore, Khairpur, Larkana, Matiari, Mirpur Khas, Naushahro Feroze, Qambar Shahdadkot, Sanghar, Shaheed Benazirabad, Shikarpur, Sujawal, Sukkur, Tando Allah Yar, Tando Muhammad Khan, Tharparkar, Thatta, Umerkot
properties.split_rationale: Thermal and coal south (Sindh + Balochistan) minus the Karachi utility territory, which is a separate control area.
properties.model_plants: Guddu, Uch, Jamshoro, Thar, Qadirpur, Karachi-Coastal, Sahiwal
properties.caveat: Sahiwal coal is in Punjab territorially but is dispatched in PAK_S by the model. The polygon follows territory.

properties.admin_units: Andijan, Bukhara, Fergana, Jizzakh, Karakalpakstan, Kashkadarya, Khorezm, Namangan, Navoiy, Samarkand, Sirdarya, Surkhandarya, Tashkent, Tashkent city
properties.split_rationale: Single meshed national system - no internal constraint is represented.
properties.model_plants: Syrdarya, Tashkent, Novo-Angren, Navoi, Talimarjan, Charvak, Fergana

properties.admin_units: Ahal, Balkan, Chardzhou, Mary, Tashauz
properties.split_rationale: Single national system; modelled as one node, exporting to Afghanistan and Iran. (Zone code TUR is the model's label for Turkmenistan - the ISO3 is TKM.)
properties.model_plants: Mary, Ahal, Derweze, Balkanabat, Turkmenbashi, Dashoguz, Lebap

properties.admin_units: Almatinskaya, Almaty City area, Jambylslkaya, Kyzylordinskaya, Yujno-kazachstanskaya
properties.split_rationale: Deficit zone around Almaty and Shymkent, historically supplied through the Central Asian ring (Uzbekistan / Kyrgyzstan) and by the North-South transit; modelled separately because that transit is the binding limit.
properties.model_plants: Balkhash-Ulken, Zhambyl GRES, Almaty CHPs, Kapchagay, Moynak, Chimkent, Shardara

properties.admin_units: Akmolinskaya, Aktyubinskaya, Karagandinskaya, Kustanayskaya, Pavlodarskaya, Severo-kazachstanskaya, Vostochno-kazachstanskaya
properties.split_rationale: Kazakhstan's UPS is three weakly-coupled zones. The Northern zone is the coal belt synchronised with Russia; it is linked to the South only by the North-South 500 kV transit, which is the constraint the model represents as the KAZ_N-KAZ_S corridor.
properties.model_plants: Ekibastuz GRES-1/2, Aksu, Karaganda, Petropavlovsk, Ust-Kamenogorsk
